Theme

Computing & programming

restart verb

a phone or computer

also reboot, turn it off and on again

* our formation

* (our own formation) dēnuō excitō, excitāre, excitāvī, excitātum

wake again: restart

Our phrase. Traupman and Andresian switch a computer or phone on with excitāre, to wake it (see switch on); to restart it is to wake it again.

Other words

  • redinitiō, redinitiāre — reboot

    verb, first conjugation · also used · modern · Traupman 262, s.v. reboot; Traupman 262

    Traupman’s coinage on his initiāre, boot up (p. 260).

See also switch on, switch off, update.

SourcesLewis & Short: denuo · Lewis & Short: excito
